primary_data.description: National-scale geodatabase of 128 Philippine river catchments with 91 morphometric and topographic characteristics including elevation, slope, drainage density, stream order, and catchment shape metrics. Dataset contains 109,050 stream network segments aggregated over 1 km lengths.

primary_software.description: Interactive ArcGIS web-application (WebAppBuilder) designed and deployed to display simplified stream network and river catchment geodatabase with filtering, querying, and download capabilities. primary_computational_methods.description: Systematic workflow for morphometric analysis including: (1) DEM preprocessing and bilinear resampling from 5m to 10m resolution; (2) flow-routing algorithms (D8 algorithm for flow direction); (3) constrained regularized smoothing (K=2, τ=0.5) to correct DEM artefacts; (4) stream network delineation using 1 km² upstream area threshold; (5) point aggregation over variable segment lengths (0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 1 km); (6) calculation of 91 morphometric characteristics (linear, areal, relief characteristics); (7) normalization of values by national mean for comparative analysis.

software_used: TopoToolbox V2 (stream network delineation, flow accumulation, catchment extraction)
methods_used: Morphometric analysis techniques (linear, areal, relief characteristics)

result.rationale: This is a SPECIAL ISSUE EDITORIAL/REVIEW PAPER, not a primary research contribution. It curates and summarizes seven existing research papers. While one constituent paper (Abdullah et al.) produced a new dataset (E-learningDJUST), the editorial itself is SECONDARY research — it synthesizes, evaluates, and contextualizes primary research outputs from others. primary_data.description: Generated multiplexed immunofluorescence imaging data from 29 cases (15 NLPHL, 4 THRLBCL, 4 LRcHL, 6 tonsil controls) with 1,344+ image tiles analyzed. Raw data explicitly stated as available upon request.

primary_software.description: Developed innovative digital image analysis workflow including: dynamic image thresholding technique (Supplementary Figure S1), colocalisation-based resolution algorithm for multi-marker cells (Supplementary Figure S2), and custom non-hierarchical binary phenotyping pipeline in open-source software with cell segmentation and detection.

primary_computational_methods.description: Novel computational methods: (1) dynamic image thresholding to minimize technical signal/background variations; (2) colocalisation-based resolution technique to resolve spurious phenotypes from contaminating signals between immune cell membranes; (3) binary phenotyping workflow with nuclear detection segmentation; (4) nearest-neighbour distance analysis between tumor cells and lymphocyte phenotypes; (5) statistical analysis using Mann-Whitney U tests with Bonferroni correction.
